receipt_attribution.event_encoding: One topic (signature),64data bytes: netSold then usdgSweptRaw, both uint256 nonindexed. Emitter must be canonical seller.
ordered_source_legs: Treasury NetMinted(seller,seller,netSold); minter and to indexed
Optional NET tax Transfer(seller,taxCollector,tax), TaxCollected(seller,pair,tax), then NET Transfer(seller,pair,netSold-tax)
Router/pair exchange delivers USDG to seller; seller measures net-new balance delta
USDG transfer seller→Treasury for measured delta, then PremiumSold(netSold,delta)
receipt_attribution.grouping: Use successful transaction receipts and ordered log indices to associate mint, canonical pairSwap, tokenTransfer and final seller event uniquely. Match both event fields against same-execution legs. Do not sum all same-transaction Treasury transfers, caller mints, swaps or direct donations. Ambiguous/missing/mismatched legs remain unreconciled rather than fabricated sales. Provider empty ranges are not proof of history completeness.
receipt_attribution.proceeds_meaning: Event is seller-reported net-new output/requested Treasury transfer, not all USDG cash. Receipt-confirmed delivery is tokenTransfer evidence to Treasury attributable to seller sale. Neither is total Treasury receipts from every source, current Treasury balance, RFV, profit after keeper gas or fiatUSD.
receipt_attribution.tax_meaning: Gross mintedNET can exceed pool receivedNET. TaxCollector NET accrual is separate and not USDG delivered to Treasury by this sale. PairSwap actualinput can also include preexisting unsynced pair balances; reconcile against tokenTransfers instead of assuming equality or multiplying by95%.

evidence_limits: Independently pinned runtime, constructor/deployment receipt and block hash, dependency storage/code and current permissions; explorer metadata is provider evidence, not an independent chain pin.

Router, pair and oracle implementation equivalence; USDG is an upgradeable ERC1967 proxy whose current and historical implementation/storage are not pinned here.
